title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE COMBAT FEEL BUILDS
why: The card was stamped v26.45 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new line names the combat feel builds since: heavy rounds that stop what they hit, the Meridian Lance kick, the active reload in the bright part of the reload ring and the Support MG spin-up. The two lines that described the retired belt, BELT KEYS and NEW BELT, are taken off the card.
now: The what is new card names the combat feel builds and drops the retired belt lines.
